## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2b0459285d9fbc13830efa8f98bef0763e14187f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md + none

PR #33592, card #33572. Inputs read: the card body and its three comments (triage, claim, os-dev-report), the PR body, the one-file net diff against `main` (+11 / -11), and the check-runs on this head. Workflows, AGENTS.md, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, `turbo.json` and the two `package.json` files were READ at this head to judge the skill, never reviewed.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set and public surface: none moved. The diff is one internal skill file under `.claude/**`; no schema, no published `skills/**` path, no gate script, no workflow. Right.
- Skill frontmatter (`name`, `description`, `metadata.internal`) untouched, so discovery and the trigger text are unchanged. Right.
- Line budget: file is 336 lines before and after, ceiling 337. Right as counted; the ratchet's own verdict is in a lane still running (see check-runs below).
- Governed reading: `.claude/**` x1, Tier S, the seat lands on this record. Right.

Check-runs on this head when read: `TypeScript Type Check` and all four `Type Check · *` lanes, `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, the three `Lint · scoped · *` lanes, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` (aggregate; its shards skipped on pull_request, as the skill now says), `Test UI`, `filter`, `Plan Test Core shards`: success. `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (carries `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, lint.yml:1062), `Lint · CI, release & engine gates` (carries `check:required-contexts`, lint.yml:3414, which scans this file) and `Lint · docs & code guards`: success. STILL IN PROGRESS, so not yet a verdict: `Test Core (1/8)`. No red on the head. The seat reads that one to its conclusion before landing; a red there is outside what this record covers.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` label present, `Check Changeset` success. `.claude/**` does not ship in any package, so nothing is published and no changeset is owed. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and on the claim agrees with the diff: no accept-set narrows or widens. Correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty. Nothing to answer.
- Deviation, fourth edit (§5 `&&` to `;`): inside the claimed file surface and on the card's subject. Accepted as in scope; judged in ④ (finding F1).
- Deviation, plain-line signature in place of an HTML comment: PR-body form, no bearing on the contract. Accepted.
- Out-of-scope finding, AGENTS.md "all of them live in one job, `TypeScript Type Check`": confirmed loose against lint.yml (the gates run in `typecheck-source-gates` and `typecheck-consumers`, aggregated by job `typecheck` at lint.yml:6465). The skill at L34 still cites that AGENTS.md section and now says two lanes where the section says one job; the skill is the accurate one. Escalated to the seat as carried: it needs a card or a seat edit, it does not block this head.
- Out-of-scope finding, `Spec property liveness` steps are fail-fast and `check:variant-docs` runs nowhere else: confirmed (spec-liveness-check.yml:57-81; the only other `variant-docs` hit under `.github/` is a comment). The dev marked it carrier none. Escalated to the seat: whether those steps gain `continue-on-error` plus a verdict step is a maintainer call on gate machinery; the playbook recording the case does not close it.

### ④ Design judgment

`.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md`. The card carries no eval prompt, so the file is judged against the card's two items, the developer's two extras, and the workflows and scripts it cites at this head.

Claims that hold, each read in the cited code:

- L28-29 "a red gate in a CI lane does not stop the rest (`lint.yml` header EVERY GATE RUNS)": lint.yml:168-189 says exactly this for every `Lint · *` and `Type Check · *` lane. A scan of lint.yml:4770-6465 finds every `run:` step without `continue-on-error` to be a build step, the cache prune, or `Lane verdict`; no gate step is fail-fast.
- L29-30 "a red build step skips the gates and tests that read it": lint.yml:174-176 (builds stay fail-fast); `Build workspace packages` at lint.yml:6008 precedes `check:api-surface` (:6116) and `check:i18n` (:6333). Test Core withholds a task whose dependency failed (ci.yml:1589-1598; `turbo.json` `test` depends on `^build`, so a test red does not withhold another package's tests, only a build red does). Holds.
- L30-31 "`Spec property liveness` is step-serial, a red `check:liveness` skips `check:variant-docs`": spec-liveness-check.yml:57-73, plain steps, no `continue-on-error`. `check:liveness` also runs in `Type Check · source gates` (lint.yml:5181) with `continue-on-error`, so the red itself is still reported there; what is hidden is `check:variant-docs`, which runs in no other workflow. Holds, and it is the gate §4 L307 says bites retirements.
- L31 "dogfood does not run on a PR, only on the merge queue (§4 last item)": ci.yml job `dogfood` carries `github.event_name != 'pull_request'` in its `if:` (ci.yml:2734, THE TWO SPEEDS note at :119-128); Test Core excludes `@objectstack/dogfood` (ci.yml:853, :1263). The pointer resolves: §4's last item (L310-314) is the `packages/qa/dogfood` item and tells the dev to run its targeted suite before pushing. Holds.
- L251-253: `check:api-surface` runs in `Type Check · consumer gates` (lint.yml:5966, :6116); the six AGENTS.md artifact gates other than it (`check:skill-docs`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:upgrade-guide`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:docs`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:react-blocks`) run in `Type Check · source gates` (lint.yml:5145-5444); both are in `needs:` of the required aggregate `TypeScript Type Check` (lint.yml:6465-6472); the lane builds before the gate. `Check Generated Artifacts` exists nowhere under `.github/`. Holds; card item 2 is met.
- Attempt to find a fourth hiding case among the gates §4 names: `check:skill-identifier-liveness` (lint.yml:2272), `check:cross-package-test-inputs` (:3420), `check:skill-top-level-keys` (:5370), `check:skill-examples` (:6270), `check:yaml-examples` (:6304), `check:exported-any` (:6175) are all lane gates under the same header; `check-changeset-no-major` is its own job in pr-automation.yml. None found. "Three" stands.
- §6, dropped trap: the AGENTS.md section it was anchored in now states the opposite for CI (AGENTS.md "Its lanes run every gate even after an earlier one is red") and `check:generated` locally ("the first failure does not stop the rest"); neither anchor file states a serial-gates trap any more. The three cases that do still hold are stated in the opening paragraph, which is where a retirement reader needs them. No rule that still holds was removed. The three remaining traps are still anchored: stale `dist` (os-dev.md L187, AGENTS.md dist bullet), pipe eats the exit code (os-dev.md L168-173), `--check` is the gate (AGENTS.md "No `check:` script regenerates anything"). Card item 1 is met.

Findings:

- **F1, should-fix. §5 L325: `pnpm check:i18n; pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` trades one hiding for another.** With `&&` a red `check:i18n` hid the tests but the invocation exited non-zero. With `;` on one line the tests run, and the line's exit status is the test command's alone: a red `check:i18n` followed by green tests exits 0. The section is titled "run the gates to where they can really fail", and the anchor this file defers to (os-dev.md L168-169) reads a gate by its exit code, captured per command (redirect to a file first, then `EXIT=$?`). A dev who runs L325 as written and captures `$?` reports a green i18n gate that was red, with the red text scrolled above a long vitest log. CI still catches it (`check:i18n` is a lane gate), so the cost is a CI round and a false gates line in the report, not a wrong merge; hence should-fix, not must-fix. The rule the developer removed (`&&`: a red is never exit 0) still holds and must survive the fix. Either form repairs it: put the two commands on their own lines like the two above them (337 lines, at the ceiling, no headroom left), or keep one line and carry both codes, for example `pnpm check:i18n; I=$?; pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test; echo "i18n=$I test=$?"`. The fix earns a delta review.
- **F2, nit. L252 "the other generated-artifact gates live in `Type Check · source gates`"** is true of the six AGENTS.md spec artifacts and not of `check:i18n`, which gates generated translation bundles (§4 L266-268) and runs in `Type Check · consumer gates` (lint.yml:6333). A reader can take "other generated-artifact gates" to include it. No effect on the api-surface instruction the sentence serves. Prose face; fix alongside F1 or leave.
- **F3, nit. L30-31 names only `check:variant-docs` as hidden.** The same serial job also hides `check:empty-state` and `check:strictness-ledger` behind a red `check:liveness`. "逐步串行" already states the mechanism and the named gate is the one that bites retirements. Leave, or accepted deviation.

No must-fix. One should-fix (F1), two nits. PASS on this head for the card's two items and the §6 edit; F1's fix moves the head and is owed a delta review, and the in-progress `Test Core (1/8)` must conclude green before the seat lands.

**VERDICT: PASS**

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`

At-tier DELTA review. PR #33592, card #33572. Base of the delta: `2b0459285d9fbc13830efa8f98bef0763e14187f`, which holds record 6887829788 (PASS; should-fix F1, nits F2 and F3). The delta is one commit, one file, +4 / -4 in three hunks (L30-31, L252, L325). Inputs read: the card body and its three comments, the PR body, record 6887829788, the delta diff and the net diff against `main` (one file, +11 / -11), and the check-runs on this head. `lint.yml`, `spec-liveness-check.yml`, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, `packages/spec/package.json` and the root `package.json` were READ at this head to judge the skill, never reviewed. Everything the base record judged outside these three hunks is byte-identical on this head and stays covered by it.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set and public surface: none moved. One internal skill file under `.claude/**`; no schema, no published `skills/**` path, no gate script, no workflow. Right.
- Frontmatter untouched; discovery and trigger text unchanged. Right.
- Line budget: 336 lines on the base and on this head, ceiling 337 (`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs:1881`), headroom 1. Right.
- Byte rule (120 per line): L252 is 116 bytes. L325 is 125 bytes and sits inside the bash fence, which `classifyLine` exempts structurally (ratchet :3057, class `fence`); no table row is touched, so the widest-row pin is unmoved. The other lines over 120 (86 to 88, 101, 114, 123, 124) are the same set as on the base. Right.
- Governed reading: `.claude/**` x1, Tier S, the seat lands on this record. Right.

Check-runs on this head when read: `TypeScript Type Check` and all four `Type Check · *` lanes, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (carries `check:pm-skill-ratchet`), `Lint · CI, release & engine gates` (carries `check:required-contexts`, which scans this file), `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, the three `Lint · scoped · *` lanes, `Check PR Size`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` (aggregate; shards skipped on pull_request), `Test UI`, `filter`, `Plan Test Core shards`, `Auto Label`: success. `Check Changeset`: skipped (the `skip-changeset` label). STILL IN PROGRESS, so not yet a verdict: `Test Core (1/8)`. No red on the head. The seat reads that one to its conclusion before landing; a red there is outside what this record covers.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged from the base record. `skip-changeset` label present; `.claude/**` ships in no package, so nothing is published and no changeset is owed. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and the claim agrees with the diff. Correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty.
- The delta commit raises no new flag and widens no surface: same file, inside the claimed surface `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/**`.
- The two out-of-scope findings the base record escalated to the seat (AGENTS.md "one job" wording; `Spec property liveness` steps fail-fast with `check:variant-docs` running nowhere else) are untouched by this delta and stay escalated as carried. The second is now stated in the playbook in full (see F3 below); stating it does not close the workflow question.
- The PR body still describes item 3 as `&&` to `;` and its Verification section still names head 2b045928. The tree is judged, not that account; noted for the seat, no effect on the contract.

### ④ Design judgment

`.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md`, the three hunks of the delta, each read against the cited code at this head.

- **F1 (was should-fix): CLOSED.** L325 is now `pnpm check:i18n; I=$?; pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test; echo "i18n=$I test=$?"`. `I=$?` is the statement directly after `pnpm check:i18n`, so it holds that command's status (root `check:i18n` is `--self-test && scan`, one status for both). The `$?` inside the echo's double quotes is expanded when the echo's words are built, before echo runs, so it is the status of the statement before it: the spec test run. Both codes are read, and the printed line lands last, below the vitest log, where the base form let the i18n red scroll away. A red `check:i18n` still does not stop the tests (`;`), and a red is no longer readable as green: the rule `&&` enforced (a red is never reported as 0) survives, in printed form. Against os-dev.md L168-170 (exit code captured before any pipe; the immune form is capture straight after the command): the line has no pipe and captures each status directly after its command, which is that rule's shape. Consistent. The trailing `#` comment after the echo is a comment to the shell, as on the two lines above it.
- **F2 (was nit): CLOSED.** L252 now reads: its gate lives in `Type Check · consumer gates`, not in `Type Check · source gates` where `check:docs` and the like spec generated-artifact gates live. lint.yml: `check:docs` at :5275 inside job `typecheck-source-gates` (:4770-5498, name at :4771), alongside `check:skill-docs` :5145, `check:spec-changes` :5193, `check:upgrade-guide` :5198, `check:authorable-surface` :5253, `check:skill-refs` :5299, `check:react-blocks` :5444; `check:api-surface` at :6116 inside `typecheck-consumers` (name :5966); both in `needs:` of `TypeScript Type Check` (:6465-6471). The qualifier "spec" plus a named exemplar no longer reads as covering `check:i18n` (root script, :6333, consumer gates). Holds.
- **F3 (was nit): CLOSED.** L30-31 now says the job is step-serial and a red step skips every later step, `check:variant-docs` included. spec-liveness-check.yml: `check:liveness` :58, `check:empty-state` :65, `check:variant-docs` :73, `check:strictness-ledger` :82, four plain `run:` steps in one job, no `continue-on-error` and no `if:` on any, so each runs only if all before it succeeded. The sentence is now true of every pair, not only liveness against variant-docs. Holds.
- Regression sweep: the delta touches no other line; the opening paragraph still counts three hiding cases and names three; the §4 pointer "§4 末项" and the §6 text are as the base record judged them. None found.

Finding on this head:

- **N1, nit. L325's own exit status is now always 0** (the echo's). The two codes are read off the printed `i18n=… test=…` line, which the comment says (两码都读); a caller that chains the whole line with `&&`, or captures `$?` after it, reads green whatever the gates did. This is the one-line form the base record offered for F1, the section is a block a dev pastes and reads, and CI runs both gates regardless, so it has no effect on correctness or the contract. Leave as an accepted deviation: folding the two codes into the line's own status costs a second line, which spends the last line of headroom.

No must-fix, no should-fix; one nit, which ends the round. PASS on this head: F1 is repaired without losing the rule it replaced, F2 and F3 are closed, and nothing else moved. The in-progress `Test Core (1/8)` must conclude green before the seat lands.
